notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check of RTIambassador::setRangeBounds validation on an adapter-supplied one-dimension region. It first accepts and commits [0, dimension upper bound], then requires InvalidRangeBound for equal and reversed bounds. These are public IEEE API exception assertions, not assertions about provider diagnostics, MOM failure payloads, or state after a failed call. The region/range service maps to clause 9.1.2 through the Requirements Lab region-lifecycle mapping. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador APIs and the C++ standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM and dimension, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It performs no region-based publication, subscription, or routing assertion.
